messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need to provision a new accelerator pool for batch-infer in us-west2. Current a100 pool is saturated during nightly jobs and autoscaler is thrashing.

samir: Agreed. How big are the spikes? numbers?

maya: Peak queued pods ~120, steady 30. We currently have 8 x a100 nodes (1 GPU each). Pod density is low for memory-heavy models.

liam: Can we increase node size instead of count? e.g., a100-8 -> a100-4 vs 4x a100-1? tradeoffs: packing, driver/nv_peer limits, pod network throughput.

gita: Also quota: GCP project quota for A100 is 16 GPUs in us-west2, so we can only add 8 more before we hit quota. We could request quota bump but that takes time.

maya: Options I'm thinking: (A) request quota bump + add 4 x a100-4 (16 GPUs) -> faster packing; (B) create mixed pool with A10G preemptible for non-critical batch jobs; (C) use H100 reserved for latency-sensitive single-request workloads and keep A100 for batch. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

samir: (B) seems cheapest. We can taint preemptible pool: key=ephemeral:NoSchedule and add tolerations on batch job specs. That prevents eviction to critical routes.

liam: Important: cluster-autoscaler behaves weird with mixed-instance pools if pods request GPUs explicitly. We need proper node labels and GPU resource naming. Use alpha.gke.io/gpu or nvidia.com/gpu? In our clusters it's nvidia.com/gpu.

maya: Example toleration snippet I propose:

```
 tolerations:
   - key: "ephemeral"
     operator: "Equal"
     value: "true"
     effect: "NoSchedule"
```

maya: And taint the pool nodes: kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=accelerator-ephemeral ephemeral=true:NoSchedule

gita: Cost note: A10G preemptible ~0.12$/hr vs A100 preemptible ~1.8$/hr. For long nightly runs it could be significant savings. But image build + init times may bump perceived throughput.

ops-sre: infra-bot: quota-check for project redwood-prod, region us-west2 -> A100 GPUs: current usage 8, limit 16; A10G GPUs: current usage 0, limit 64.

samir: Good — we have room for A10G. If we deploy an ephemeral A10G pool we should set max surge for nodepool autoscaler to avoid sudden 100% preemptions. Also set friendly pod disruption budgets on batch controllers.

liam: Networking: note that adding bigger nodes increases pod density -> ephemeral ports, iptables conntrack pressure and VPC SNAT gateway limits. We should update nodeLocalDNS and increase conntrack on node OS image via sysctl.

maya: I'll draft a nodepool manifest for GKE:

```
resource: NodePool
name: accelerator-ephemeral-a10g
autoscaling:
  enabled: true
  minNodeCount: 0
  maxNodeCount: 12
config:
  machineType: n1-standard-32
  accelerators:
    - acceleratorType: "a100"
      acceleratorCount: 1
  preemptible: true
  taints:
    - key: "ephemeral"
      value: "true"
      effect: "NO_SCHEDULE"
```

maya: (above is rough — will update machineType/accelerator mapping for A10G).

gita: One more constraint: regional quota vs zone. For failover we want multi-zone pools in us-west2-a/b. That spreads quota requests though some zones might have no A10G capacity.

samir: And add a fallback routing policy in Redwood runtime to fallback to hosted endpoints if pooled capacity not available: set policy to prefer 'dedicated' then 'ephemeral' then 'hosted'.

ops-sre: ops-sre: If we go with mixed pools we must update monitoring alerts: GPU allocation > 85% over 10m, GPU queue length > 50, and autoscaler failure events. I'll add runbook.

liam: Also check node startup hooks: nvidia-driver install time on preemptible nodes should be pre-baked in node image to avoid long boot. Use cos-gpu image with drivers baked.

maya: Next steps: 1) I'll open quota request for A100 bump to 32 in us-west2 (but prioritize A10G deploy since quotas allow it). 2) I'll create accelerator-ephemeral-a10g nodepool with min=0 max=12 preemptible. 3) ops-sre will add alerts + runbook. 4) samir will update batch job tolerations and PDBs.

gita: timeline?

maya: aiming for deploy tomorrow evening (off-peak). Will post PR for nodepool config and k8s job changes. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: New nodepool PR created at https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/3425 — reviewers: @maya @gita @samir

samir: I'll review the PR tonight. Quick reminder to include cost tag on nodepool: "env:batch" and "billing:accelerator-ephemeral" so billing reports pick it up.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with exact gcloud commands and the quota ticket ID in the thread.
